csv_project_name: PM for Levy County New Emergency Operations Center
csv_scope_of_work: The County is soliciting sealed proposals from qualified professional firms for the construction of a new Levy County Emergency Operations Center (EOC) on new site, and renovation of the existing EOC for Levy County Sheriff Dispatch. The scope of work is construction of a new Levy County EOC on new site and Renovation of the existing EOC for Levy County Sheriff Dispatch. The EOC facility will consist of approximately 12,000 square feet including EOC and Logistics Storage building with associated parking on new site. The 911 Dispatch will consist of renovation of approximately 3,500 sf and new addition of 3,000 gsf for 911 dispatch on existing EOC site.
